INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Social writing - SMS.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills.

7. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

9. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Only memorise without using the language

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.3.1 Writing for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Conversational Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Reading for information - Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing – Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
